# Settings
```{r}
# ================================================
# Paths and analysis options
# ================================================

# ---- Paths ----
BA_OUT    <- normalizePath("~/fNIRS/ELM_BA_outputs", mustWork = TRUE)   # run_main_ba output folder
UCLA_PATH <- normalizePath("~/fNIRS/ELM/ucla_loneliness_scores.csv", mustWork = TRUE)
OUT_DIR   <- file.path(BA_OUT, "isc", "lmm_results")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- Options ----
CHROMOPHORES <- c("HbO", "HbR")
VIDEOS       <- NULL          # NULL = all videos; e.g. c("Zima", "Splitscreen")
EXCLUDE_IDS  <- c()           # e.g. c("S76") (subjects removed from all dyads)
VIDEO_TERM   <- "fixed"       # "fixed": loneliness + video;  "random": (1|stimulus)
LONELY_VAR   <- "ucla_max"    # dyad loneliness: "ucla_max", "ucla_min" or "ucla_mean"
```

# ROI map
```{r}
# map ROI to list of channels (same montage / channel order as probeInfo)
roi_map <- list(
    vmPFC  = c("S1-D1","S1-D8","S1-D9"),
    dmPFC  = c("S9-D11", "S9-D9", "S9-D3", "S2-D9", "S10-D9"),
    ldlPFC = c("S2-D2","S4-D2", "S4-D3", "S4-D5", "S6-D2", "S6-D5", "S3-D2"),
    rdlPFC = c("S10-D10", "S10-D11", "S12-D11", "S12-D10", "S12-D12", "S14-D12", "S14-D10", "S11-D10"),
    lTPJ   = c("S8-D7","S8-D6","S7-D7","S7-D6"),
    rTPJ   = c("S15-D14","S15-D13","S16-D14","S16-D13")
)

roi_names <- list("vmPFC", "dmPFC", "ldlPFC", "rdlPFC", "lTPJ", "rTPJ")

channel_names <- as.list(unique(c(
  roi_map$vmPFC,
  roi_map$dmPFC,
  roi_map$ldlPFC,
  roi_map$rdlPFC,
  roi_map$lTPJ,
  roi_map$rTPJ
)))
```

# Load ISC + loneliness
```{r}
# ================================================
# Load dyadic AR-ISC (from ba_video_isc.m) and UCLA scores
#   channel ISC: isc/dyad_video_channel_ar_isc.csv
#   ROI ISC:     isc/dyad_video_roi_ar_isc.csv
#                (ROI = mean of the subject's valid channels, then ar_corr)
# ================================================

# ---- Libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Read ISC ----
read_isc <- function(file, unit_col) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(id1 = sub1, id2 = sub2, stimulus = Video, unit = all_of(unit_col)) %>%
    mutate(across(c(id1, id2, stimulus, Chromophore, unit), as.character))
}

isc_channel <- read_isc(file.path(BA_OUT, "isc", "dyad_video_channel_ar_isc.csv"), "Channel")
isc_roi     <- read_isc(file.path(BA_OUT, "isc", "dyad_video_roi_ar_isc.csv"), "ROI")

# Keep the ROI channels only (channels outside the ROI map are not modelled)
isc_channel <- isc_channel %>% filter(unit %in% unlist(channel_names))

# ---- UCLA (pid "02" -> id "S02") ----
ucla <- read_csv(UCLA_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE,
                 col_types = cols(pid = col_character())) %>%
  transmute(id = paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", as.integer(pid))), ucla = ucla_total)

# ---- Dyad-level loneliness ----
add_dyad_loneliness <- function(df, ucla) {
  df %>%
    filter(!id1 %in% EXCLUDE_IDS, !id2 %in% EXCLUDE_IDS) %>%
    { if (is.null(VIDEOS)) . else filter(., stimulus %in% VIDEOS) } %>%
    left_join(ucla %>% rename(id1 = id, ucla1 = ucla), by = "id1") %>%
    left_join(ucla %>% rename(id2 = id, ucla2 = ucla), by = "id2") %>%
    filter(!is.na(ucla1), !is.na(ucla2), is.finite(isc_z)) %>%
    mutate(
      ucla_max  = pmax(ucla1, ucla2),
      ucla_min  = pmin(ucla1, ucla2),
      ucla_mean = (ucla1 + ucla2) / 2
    )
}

isc_channel <- add_dyad_loneliness(isc_channel, ucla)
isc_roi     <- add_dyad_loneliness(isc_roi, ucla)

# ---- Median split restricted to ISC participants (as in ISC_lmm.Rmd) ----
isc_ids <- unique(c(isc_channel$id1, isc_channel$id2))
isc_median <- median(ucla$ucla[ucla$id %in% isc_ids], na.rm = TRUE)
message("ISC participants: ", length(isc_ids), " | UCLA median = ", isc_median)

make_dyad_type <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      lonely1 = ucla1 > isc_median,
      lonely2 = ucla2 > isc_median,
      binarized_lonely = case_when(
        lonely1 & lonely2   ~ "HH",
        !lonely1 & !lonely2 ~ "LL",
        TRUE                ~ "HL"
      ),
      binarized_lonely = factor(binarized_lonely, levels = c("HH", "HL", "LL"))
    )
}

isc_channel <- make_dyad_type(isc_channel)
isc_roi     <- make_dyad_type(isc_roi)

# ---- Audit ----
isc_roi %>% distinct(id1, id2, stimulus) %>% count(stimulus, name = "n_dyads")
isc_roi %>% count(Chromophore, unit)
```

# Model helpers
```{r}
# ================================================
# Dyadic LMM helpers (same approach as ISC_lmm.Rmd)
#   - every dyad entered twice (sub1/sub2 swapped) -> crossed (1|sub1) + (1|sub2)
#   - SE corrected for the doubling; p penalized with df = unique dyads - 1
# ================================================

# Z-score function
zstd <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))

# Doubling function
double_for_lmm <- function(df) {
  d1 <- df %>% mutate(sub1 = id1, sub2 = id2)
  d2 <- df %>% mutate(sub1 = id2, sub2 = id1)
  bind_rows(d1, d2) %>% mutate(outcome = isc_z)
}

n_unique_dyads <- function(df) {
  df %>% transmute(a = pmin(id1, id2), b = pmax(id1, id2)) %>% distinct() %>% nrow()
}

# Video term: fixed (loneliness + video) or random intercept
video_rhs <- function(df) {
  if (n_distinct(df$stimulus) < 2) return("")
  if (VIDEO_TERM == "fixed") " + stimulus" else " + (1|stimulus)"
}

lmm_control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))

# ---- Continuous loneliness ----
fit_continuous <- function(df, lonely_var = LONELY_VAR) {
  n_dyads <- n_unique_dyads(df)
  doubled <- double_for_lmm(df)
  doubled$lonely_z <- zstd(doubled[[lonely_var]])
  f <- as.formula(paste0("outcome ~ lonely_z", video_rhs(df), " + (1|sub1) + (1|sub2)"))
  model <- tryCatch(lmer(f, data = doubled, control = lmm_control), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

  coef_row <- summary(model)$coefficients["lonely_z", ]
  B  <- coef_row["Estimate"]; SE <- coef_row["Std. Error"]; t <- coef_row["t value"]

  # ---- SE correction for doubled dyads ----
  mult <- sqrt(2 * n_dyads - 1) / sqrt(n_dyads - 1)

  data.frame(
    predictor    = lonely_var,
    B            = unname(B),
    t            = unname(t),
    SE           = unname(SE),
    SE_corrected = unname(SE * mult),
    p_asymp      = unname(coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]),
    p_penalized  = 2 * pt(-abs(unname(t)), df = n_dyads - 1),
    n_dyads      = n_dyads,
    singular     = isSingular(model)
  )
}

# ---- Binarized loneliness: planned contrasts ----
fit_contrasts <- function(df) {
  if (n_distinct(df$binarized_lonely) < 3) return(NULL)
  n_dyads <- n_unique_dyads(df)
  doubled <- double_for_lmm(df)
  f <- as.formula(paste0("outcome ~ binarized_lonely", video_rhs(df), " + (1|sub1) + (1|sub2)"))
  model <- tryCatch(lmer(f, data = doubled, control = lmm_control), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

  Contrasts <- list(HHvsLL = c(1, 0, -1), HHvsHL = c(1, -1, 0), HLvsLL = c(0, 1, -1))
  emm_res <- emmeans(model, ~ binarized_lonely, contr = Contrasts,
                     adjust = "none", lmer.df = "asymp")
  cont <- summary(emm_res$contrasts)
  mult <- sqrt(2 * n_dyads - 1) / sqrt(n_dyads - 1)
  t <- cont$estimate / cont$SE

  data.frame(
    predictor    = as.character(cont$contrast),
    B            = cont$estimate,
    t            = t,
    SE           = cont$SE,
    SE_corrected = cont$SE * mult,
    p_asymp      = cont$p.value,
    p_penalized  = 2 * pt(-abs(t), df = n_dyads - 1),
    n_dyads      = n_dyads,
    singular     = isSingular(model)
  )
}

# ---- Run one model type over every chromophore x unit ----
run_all <- function(df, fit_fun, level) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Chromophore, unit) %>%
    group_modify(~ { res <- fit_fun(.x); if (is.null(res)) tibble() else as_tibble(res) }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(level = level) %>%
    group_by(Chromophore, predictor, level) %>%
    mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p_penalized, method = "BH")) %>%   # FDR across channels / ROIs
    ungroup() %>%
    relocate(level, Chromophore, unit, predictor)
}
```

# ROI level
```{r}
# ================================================
# isc_z ~ loneliness + video + (1|sub1) + (1|sub2), per ROI and chromophore
# ================================================
roi_cont <- run_all(isc_roi, fit_continuous, "ROI")
roi_bin  <- run_all(isc_roi, fit_contrasts,  "ROI")

roi_cont
roi_bin

write_csv(roi_cont, file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("roi_%s_%s.csv", LONELY_VAR, VIDEO_TERM)))
write_csv(roi_bin,  file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("roi_binarized_%s.csv", VIDEO_TERM)))

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(roi_cont, aes(x = unit, y = B, color = Chromophore)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = B - SE_corrected, ymax = B + SE_corrected),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "ROI", y = paste0("Effect of z(", LONELY_VAR, ") on ISC (Fisher z)"),
       title = "fNIRS ISC ~ loneliness, ROI level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

# Channel level
```{r}
# ================================================
# Same models per channel (ROI channels only); FDR across channels
# ================================================
chan_cont <- run_all(isc_channel, fit_continuous, "channel")
chan_bin  <- run_all(isc_channel, fit_contrasts,  "channel")

chan_cont %>% arrange(p_penalized)
chan_bin  %>% arrange(p_penalized)

write_csv(chan_cont, file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("channel_%s_%s.csv", LONELY_VAR, VIDEO_TERM)))
write_csv(chan_bin,  file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("channel_binarized_%s.csv", VIDEO_TERM)))

# ---- Plot: t per channel, coloured by ROI ----
chan_roi <- stack(roi_map) %>% rename(unit = values, ROI = ind)

chan_cont %>%
  left_join(chan_roi, by = "unit") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(unit, levels = unlist(channel_names)), y = t, fill = ROI)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Chromophore, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Channel", y = "t (loneliness)", title = "fNIRS ISC ~ loneliness, channel level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
```
